Message.Name: Seconds Message
Message.Description: This message is sent every second for which at least one ITCH message is being generated. The message contains the number of seconds since the start of 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC, also called Unix Time

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: Unix time (number of seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Message.Name: Order Book Directory
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Order book directory messages are disseminated for all active securities, including halted securities, in the Genium INET Trading system. Intra-day transmissions of this message may occur when new order books are added to the system; updates to existing order books may also be represented by intra-day Order book Directory messages

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book. NOTE: Expired Order book IDs may be reused for new instruments

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security short name

Field.Name: Long Name
Field.Description: Human-readable long name of security

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: ISIN code identifying security

Field.Name: Financial Product
Field.Description: Financial product of the order book

Field.Name: Trading Currency
Field.Description: Trading currency

Field.Name: Number Of Decimals In Price
Field.Description: Number of decimals used in price for this order book. NOTE: A value of 256 means that the instrument is traded in fractions (each fraction is 1/256)

Field.Name: Number Of Decimals In Nominal Value
Field.Description: Number of decimals in Nominal Value

Field.Name: Odd Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represent an odd lot for the order book. NOTE: A value of 0 indicates that this lot type is undefined for the order book

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the quantity that represents a round lot for the issue

Field.Name: Block Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represents an odd lot for the order book (the document repeats the Odd Lot Size wording for this block lot field). NOTE: A value of 0 indicates that this lot type is undefined for the order book

Field.Name: Nominal Value
Field.Description: Nominal value

Message.Name: Combination Order Book Directory
Message.Description: Specialized directory message used when Combination order books are traded in the marketplace. It represents both standard combinations defined by the exchange and tailor-made combinations created by members. Intra-day transmissions may occur when new combination order books are added, typically for tailor-made combinations

Message.Name: Tick Size Table Entry
Message.Description: Contains information on a tick size for a price range. Together, all Tick Size messages with the same order book ID form a complete Tick Size Table. The number of decimals in prices are given by the Order Book Directory message for this order book

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: The order book to which this entry belongs

Field.Name: Tick Size
Field.Description: Tick Size for the given price range

Field.Name: Price From
Field.Description: Start of price range for this entry

Field.Name: Price To
Field.Description: End of price range for this entry. Zero (0) means infinity

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: The system supports the following event codes on a daily basis: O = Start of Messages. Outside of time stamp messages, the start of day message is the first message sent in any trading day. C = End of Messages. This is always the last message sent in any trading day

Message.Name: Order Book State Message
Message.Description: The Order book state message relays information on state changes

Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: State Name
Field.Description: Name of Order Book State

Message.Name: Stressed Market Message
Message.Description: The Stressed Market Message is sent whenever the Stressed Market state has changed

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book

Field.Name: Stressed Market
Field.Description: Values: Y = Yes, stressed market is active. N = No, stressed market is not active

Message.Name: Exceptional Market Message
Message.Description: The Exceptional Market Message is sent whenever the Exceptional Market state has changed

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book

Field.Name: Exceptional Market
Field.Description: Values: Y = Yes, exceptional market is active. N = No, exceptional market is not active

Message.Name: Add Order No MPID Attribution
Message.Description: Add Order Message. Indicates that a new order has been accepted by the Genium INET Trading system and was added to the displayable book. Generated for unattributed orders

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the new order. NOTE: The number is only unique per Order book and side

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order. Values: B = buy order, S = sell order

Field.Name: Order Book Position
Field.Description: Rank within order book. See Appendix A, How to Build an Order Book View

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The visible quantity of the order. NOTE: Orders with an undisclosed quantity will have this field set to 0

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order. See Data Types for field processing notes

Field.Name: Order Attributes
Field.Description: Additional order attributes. Values: 0 = Not applicable, 1 = Force, 2 = Short Sell, 4 = Market Bid, 8 = Price Stabilization, 16 = Override Crossing, 32 = Undisclosed, 1024 = Fill-and-kill immediately, 2048 = Firm color disabled, 4096 = Convert to aggressive (if locked market), 8192 = Bait/implied order. NOTE: Applicable types may be defined by the marketplace. NOTE: This field is a bit map. Multiple values may be set simultaneously

Field.Name: Lot Type
Field.Description: Lot Type. Values: 0 = Undefined, 1 = Odd Lot, 2 = Round Lot, 3 = Block Lot, 4 = All or None Lot

Field.Name: Participant Id

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part. Multiple Order Executed Messages on the same order are cumulative

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The order ID associated with the executed order

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order. Values: B = buy order, S = sell order

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: The quantity being executed

Field.Name: Match Id
Field.Description: Assigned by the system to each match executed

Field.Name: Participant Id Owner
Field.Description: Participant ID, owner. NOTE: Will be set to blank (space) for anonymous markets

Field.Name: Participant Id Counterparty
Field.Description: Participant ID, counterparty. NOTE: Will be set to blank (space) for anonymous markets

Message.Name: Order Executed With Price Message
Message.Description: Sent in the relatively rare event that an order on the book is executed in whole or in part with a price different than the initial display price. Combination orders on the book that execute are always represented by this message, with the Printable flag set to N

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The order ID associated with the executed order

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order. Values: B = buy order, S = sell order

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: The quantity being executed

Field.Name: Match Id
Field.Description: Assigned by the system to each match executed

Field.Name: Participant Id Owner
Field.Description: Participant ID, owner. NOTE: Will be set to blank (space) for anonymous markets

Field.Name: Participant Id Counterparty
Field.Description: Participant ID, counterparty. NOTE: Will be set to blank (space) for anonymous markets

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Trade price

Field.Name: Occurred At Cross
Field.Description: Values: Y = Yes, trade occurred at the cross. N = No, trade occurred at continuous market

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the trade should be included in trade tickers and volume calculations. Values: N = non-printable, Y = printable

Message.Name: Order Replace Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an existing order on the book has been modified through an alter action. The Side, Order book ID and attribution (if any) remain the same as the original order. NOTE: The Order Replace Message is not used, it remains in the ITCH specification for future reference

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The original order identifier of the order being replaced. NOTE: The Order ID is only unique per order book and side and does not change when the order is replaced

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order. Values: B = buy order, S = sell order

Field.Name: New Order Book Position
Field.Description: New Rank within order book. See Appendix A, How to Build an Order Book View

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: New visible quantity of the order

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: New Price of the order

Field.Name: Order Attributes
Field.Description: Additional order attributes. Values: 0 = Not applicable, 1 = Force, 2 = Short Sell, 4 = Market Bid, 8 = Price Stabilization, 16 = Override Crossing, 32 = Undisclosed, 1024 = Fill-and-kill immediately, 2048 = Firm color disabled, 4096 = Convert to aggressive (if locked market), 8192 = Bait/implied order. NOTE: Applicable types may be defined by the marketplace. NOTE: This field is a bit map. Multiple values may be set simultaneously

Message.Name: Order Delete Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an order on the book is being deleted. Order Deletes are also sent when an order with an undisclosed quantity is fully filled, when orders are suspended due to connection loss, and for all existing orders prior to an auction where market by order dissemination is disabled

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The original order identifier of the order being deleted. NOTE: The Order ID is only unique per order book and side

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order. Values: B = buy order, S = sell order

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: Provides execution details for normal match events involving non-displayable order types, and is also used to publish individual cross trades

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Timestamp - Nanoseconds. Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Match Id
Field.Description: Assigned by the system to each match executed

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Type of non-display order on the book being matched. Values: B = buy order, S = sell order. Will be set to blank (space) for anonymous markets

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity being matched in this execution

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier. The document states offset 28 for this field; 26 is where Quantity (18, length 8) ends and where revision 1.06 places it, and Trade Price follows at 30

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Trade price

Field.Name: Participant Id Owner
Field.Description: Participant ID, owner. NOTE: Will be set to blank (spaces) for anonymous markets

Field.Name: Participant Id Counterparty
Field.Description: Participant ID, counterparty. NOTE: Will be set to blank (spaces) for anonymous markets

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the trade should be included in trade tickers and volume calculations. Values: N = non-printable, Y = printable

Field.Name: Occurred At Cross
Field.Description: Values: Y = Yes, trade occurred at the cross. N = No, trade occurred at continuous market

Message.Name: Equilibrium Price Update
Message.Description: Used when auctions occur. The message provides the changes in equilibrium price. If any Price field has bit 31 set (the highest bit, MIN_INT) while all other bits are zero (decimal -2147483648), this means that no price is available

Field.Name: Available Bid Quantity At Equilibrium Price
Field.Description: Quantity at equilibrium price on the bid side

Field.Name: Available Ask Quantity At Equilibrium Price
Field.Description: Quantity at equilibrium price on the ask side

Field.Name: Equilibrium Price
Field.Description: Equilibrium Price
